newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VOLATILE CHICAGO KEEPS LID ON EUROPEAN FEEDS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: VOLATILE CHICAGO KEEPS LID ON EUROPEAN FEEDS TRADE.

text.p: Volatile Chicago soymeal futures, dominated by U.S. Midwest weather forecasts, discouraged most buyers on the European meals and feeds market from entering the market, dealers said.
After a sharp rise in Chicago soymeal futures on Wednesday on drier weather the market opened well down on Thursday on forecasts for more rain is U.S. soybean growing areas.

"We know this weather game in July and August takes place every year and still nobody here in Europe has an answer how to cope with it and operators therefore decide to stay sidelined," one broker said.
